notes: chart 0.10.0 -> 0.10.1, app 1.11.9 and vLLM image unchanged. The chart renders the sandbox-api integers through int64: Helm 3.21.1 wrote 1800000 as 1.8e+06 and sandbox-api read it as 1 ms, so every sandbox session and workbench was stopped a minute after creation on such a box. values.yaml already carries the two idle limits as quoted strings; the chart now renders them in full whatever their form.
